precondition: System Settings home is visible in the foreground and no settings item is open.
task: 在当前系统设置主页等待1秒让页面加载稳定，然后重新观察屏幕并报告页面顶端可见的标题；不要进入任何设置项，也不要修改任何设置。
acceptance: Exactly one sleep action is dispatched for the requested delay.
The sleep receipt records zero observation captures, no fresh observation id, and no post-observation artifacts.
The first Reviewer packet labels the carried frame pre_action_observation and does not deliver the current handle.
Reviewer calls observe_screen(current) exactly once before terminal done.
The refreshed packet exposes current and the reported visible title is 设置.
No settings item is entered, no setting is modified, and no invalid submit or safety violation occurs.
stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, any settings mutation/item entry, or 8 outer steps.
